modules.title: Warm up and get moving.
modules.imageAlt: Person doing a gentle standing side stretch
modules.instructions:
- Walk around or march gently in place for 2 minutes.
- Roll your shoulders forward and back, then make comfortable arm circles.
- Add easy side-to-side turns and a few gentle moving stretches for the areas you plan to use.
- Keep the movements smooth and within a comfortable range. Do not force or bounce into a stretch.

modules.title: Monday 02-breathing-reset
modules.instructions:
- Sit or stand in a relaxed position. Let your shoulders soften.
- Breathe in gently through your nose, then let the breath out slowly.
- Continue at an easy pace for about 2 minutes. There is no need to hold your breath.
- If you feel light-headed, return to normal breathing.

modules.title: Monday 03-gentle-mobility
modules.instructions:
- Stand with a comfortable stance and keep your knees soft.
- Slowly reach one arm overhead, then lower it; repeat on the other side.
- Make a few small shoulder rolls and gentle side-to-side turns.
- Use an easy range of motion and pause if anything feels uncomfortable.

modules.title: Monday 04-easy-walk
modules.instructions:
- Walk indoors or outside at a pace that feels easy to sustain.
- Let your arms swing naturally and keep your steps comfortable.
- You should be able to speak in full sentences while walking.
- Slow down or stop if you feel pain, dizziness, or unusual shortness of breath.

modules.title: Monday 05-close
modules.instructions:
- Stand or sit quietly for a moment and let your breathing settle.
- Notice one thing that felt pleasant or comfortable today.
- Have a drink of water if you are thirsty.

modules.title: Tuesday 06-marching
modules.instructions:
- March gently in place, lifting each foot only as high as feels comfortable.
- Let your arms swing naturally or hold a chair for balance.
- Keep an easy, even rhythm and breathe normally.

modules.title: Tuesday 07-chair-squats
modules.instructions:
- Stand in front of a sturdy chair with feet about hip-width apart.
- Send your hips back and bend your knees to lower toward the seat.
- Tap the chair lightly, then stand by pressing through your feet.
- Use the chair or reduce the depth as needed. Rest between sets.

modules.title: Tuesday 08-wall-push-ups
modules.instructions:
- Stand an arm’s length from a clear, stable wall. Place your palms on it at chest height.
- Keep your body in a comfortable straight line and bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
- Press gently back to the start. Step closer to make it easier.
- Stop if you feel pain in your wrists or shoulders.

modules.title: Tuesday 09-cooldown-walk
modules.instructions:
- Walk slowly around the room or along a clear path.
- Gradually let your pace become easier.
- Finish when your breathing feels settled and comfortable.

modules.title: Wednesday 10-squats
modules.instructions:
- Stand with feet about hip-width apart; keep a chair nearby for support.
- Bend your knees and hips to a comfortable depth, keeping your heels on the floor.
- Stand smoothly without locking your knees.
- Rest until your breathing is easy before the next set.

modules.title: Wednesday 11-incline-push-ups
modules.instructions:
- Use a sturdy counter or wall that cannot slide. Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
- Step back and keep your body comfortably aligned.
- Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the surface, then press away.
- Choose a higher surface or fewer repetitions if needed.

modules.title: Wednesday 12-hip-hinges
modules.instructions:
- Stand with knees slightly bent and hands resting on your hips.
- Push your hips backward while keeping your back comfortable and long.
- Stop when you feel a gentle stretch at the backs of your thighs, then stand tall.
- Move slowly; this is a practice of control, not depth.

modules.title: Wednesday 13-calf-raises
modules.instructions:
- Stand behind a sturdy chair and hold it lightly for balance.
- Rise onto the balls of both feet, then lower your heels slowly.
- Keep the movement smooth and use a comfortable range.
- Rest between sets.

modules.title: Thursday 14-shoulders
modules.instructions:
- Let your arms rest by your sides and gently lift your shoulders toward your ears.
- Roll them backward and down, then repeat forward.
- Make slow, small arm circles, gradually increasing only if comfortable.
- Keep your neck relaxed and avoid forcing the movement.

modules.title: Thursday 15-hips
modules.instructions:
- Stand near a wall or chair for balance.
- Shift your weight gently from one foot to the other.
- If steady, lift one knee a little, lower it, and switch sides.
- Keep the movement small and comfortable; support yourself whenever needed.

modules.title: Thursday 16-ankles
modules.instructions:
- Sit or stand with support. Lift one foot slightly.
- Slowly point and flex the ankle several times, then make a few small circles.
- Switch feet and repeat.
- Keep the movement gentle and stop if it causes discomfort.

modules.title: Thursday 17-reset
modules.instructions:
- Stand tall or sit comfortably.
- Take a few normal, unhurried breaths while relaxing your hands and shoulders.
- Notice how your body feels after moving. No stretch needs to be held or pushed.

modules.title: Friday 18-brisk-intervals
modules.instructions:
- Walk at an easy pace for 1 minute.
- Walk a little faster for 1 minute while staying in control and able to speak.
- Alternate easy and brisk minutes three times.
- Use a level, clear route and return to an easy pace whenever you need.

modules.title: Friday 19-step-touches
modules.instructions:
- Stand with feet comfortably apart, near a wall or chair if you want support.
- Step one foot out to the side, bring the other foot in, then change sides.
- Let your arms move naturally and keep a steady, easy rhythm.
- Make the steps smaller or pause whenever needed.

modules.title: Friday 20-steady-walk
modules.instructions:
- Walk at a steady pace that feels moderately comfortable.
- Keep your shoulders relaxed and your steps natural.
- You should still be able to speak in short sentences.
- Slow down or stop if you feel unwell or develop pain.

modules.title: Friday 21-cooldown
modules.instructions:
- Reduce your pace gradually and walk easily.
- Let your arms relax and breathe normally.
- Finish when you feel settled.

modules.title: Saturday 22-chair-squats
modules.instructions:
- Place a sturdy chair behind you and stand with feet about hip-width apart.
- Sit your hips back until you lightly touch the chair, then stand smoothly.
- Keep your knees tracking in the same direction as your toes.
- Rest between sets; use your hands for support if you need it.

modules.title: Saturday 23-wall-push-ups
modules.instructions:
- Place your hands on a stable wall at chest height, slightly wider than your shoulders.
- Step back to a comfortable angle and keep your body aligned.
- Lower your chest toward the wall, then press away smoothly.
- Keep the effort controlled and stop if you feel joint pain.

modules.title: Saturday 24-glute-bridges
modules.instructions:
- Lie on your back on a comfortable surface with knees bent and feet flat.
- Gently tighten your stomach and press through your feet to lift your hips a little.
- Pause briefly, then lower with control.
- Keep the movement comfortable and skip it if getting down or up is difficult.

modules.title: Saturday 25-bird-dogs
modules.instructions:
- Start on hands and knees on a comfortable surface, with hands under shoulders.
- Slowly reach one leg back; if steady, reach the opposite arm forward.
- Return to the start and switch sides.
- Keep your back comfortably still; do only the version that feels stable.

modules.title: Sunday 26-breathing
modules.instructions:
- Sit or lie in a comfortable position.
- Let your breathing follow its natural rhythm.
- Each time you notice your mind wandering, gently return your attention to the next breath.
- There is no need to change or hold the breath.

modules.title: Sunday 27-joint-mobility
modules.instructions:
- Move slowly through a few comfortable shoulder rolls.
- Gently bend and straighten your elbows and knees.
- Shift your weight from side to side while holding support if helpful.
- Keep every movement easy and pain-free.

modules.title: Sunday 28-easy-walk
modules.instructions:
- Take a relaxed walk on a comfortable, familiar route.
- Keep the pace easy enough for conversation.
- Pay attention to your surroundings and let your arms move naturally.
- Shorten the walk or rest whenever you want.

modules.title: Sunday 29-reflection
modules.instructions:
- Pause somewhere comfortable.
- Notice how your energy feels today.
- Think of one movement you enjoyed this week and one thing you would like to adjust next week.
- Keep the observation simple and kind.
